description: This file defines the ParamChecker utility class, which provides static methods for validating method parameters such as null checks, emptiness checks for various collection types, bounds checks, and bit validation. It helps enforce parameter constraints across the project.

classes.name: ParamChecker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for validating parameters, such as null checks, emptiness checks for strings, collections, maps, bounds checks for integers, and bit validation.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks that the given object parameter is not null; throws IllegalArgumentException if it is null.

methods.name: checkNotNull (varargs)
methods.description: Checks multiple parameters that are passed as varargs for null values.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (String)
methods.description: Checks that the string parameter is neither null nor empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (Object[])
methods.description: Checks that the array parameter is neither null nor empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Checks that the collection parameter is neither null nor empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (Map)
methods.description: Checks that the map parameter is neither null nor empty.

methods.name: checkGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that the integer parameter is greater than zero.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (byte array)
methods.description: Checks that the byte array parameter is not null and has at least one element.

methods.name: checkBit
methods.description: Validates that the provided bit index is between 0 and 7 inclusive.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (String)
methods.description: Returns true if the string parameter is null or has zero length.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Returns true if the collection parameter is null or empty.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (Map)
methods.description: Returns true if the map parameter is null or empty.

methods.name: isValidBit
methods.description: Checks whether the integer is a valid bit index (0-7).
